about.title: Discover More About Menupedia
about.description: Menupedia is your premier online destination for exploring local eateries and their delightful menus. We connect passionate food lovers with a diverse array of culinary experiences, making it effortless to find exactly what you crave. Our core mission is to simplify your dining choices, champion local businesses, and showcase the very best of local gastronomy.

themes.title: Why Choose Menupedia?
themes.description: Menupedia simplifies restaurant menu management and discovery. We offer intuitive tools for businesses and a rich, user-friendly experience for diners. Our focus on local gastronomy means you support your community while exploring diverse culinary options. With seamless integration and dynamic display themes, we make digital menus engaging and effortless.

aboutPage.mainDescription: Menupedia is your ultimate online platform for discovering and exploring local restaurants and their diverse culinary offerings. We connect food lovers with a wide array of dining experiences, making it easier than ever to find exactly what you crave. Our mission is to simplify your dining choices and highlight the best of local gastronomy, all in one convenient place.
aboutPage.whatWeOfferDescription: Menupedia provides a seamless experience for both diners and restaurant owners.

forDiners.title: For Diners:
forDiners.description: Easy access to dedicated restaurant menus, categorized dishes, detailed item information (including ingredients and dietary labels), and beautiful imagery. Discover new favorites effortlessly.

forRestaurantOwners.title: For Restaurant Owners:
forRestaurantOwners.description: A powerful admin dashboard to manage your restaurant's profile, menu categories, and individual menu items. Upload images, set prices, and update dietary information with ease.

customizableThemes.title: Customizable Themes:
customizableThemes.description: Restaurants can choose from various display themes to match their brand's unique style, ensuring a personalized customer experience.

optimizedForAllDevices.title: Optimized for All Devices:
optimizedForAllDevices.description: Our platform is designed to provide an optimal viewing and Browse experience on both mobile phones and desktop computers.

simplicity.title: Simplicity:
simplicity.description: We strive to make online menu management and discovery as straightforward as possible.

innovation.title: Innovation:
innovation.description: We continuously improve our platform with new features and technologies.

userExperience.title: User Experience:
userExperience.description: We prioritize intuitive design for both restaurant owners and their customers.

reliability.title: Reliability:
reliability.description: Built on a robust stack, Menupedia offers consistent performance.

aboutPage.getStartedDescription: Ready to streamline your restaurant's online presence or discover your next favorite meal? Explore Menupedia today!

Share.linkDescription: For your website, social media bio or messages.

Share.printNotLive: Your menu isn't live yet. The cards will work as soon as it is.
Share.layoutA4: A4 sheet, 4 cards to cut out

Share.scansNote: Counts scans of the QR code only, not visits from the typed link. Repeat scans from the same phone within 30 minutes count once, and link previews in chat apps aren't counted. Days follow UTC time. No personal data is stored.

MenuLanguages.title: Menu languages
MenuLanguages.intro: Offer the menu in more than one language. Guests see it in their language when it's translated, and in the main language otherwise.
MenuLanguages.enableText: Lets this restaurant's owners choose languages and its team translate the menu. Turning it off hides translations but keeps them.
MenuLanguages.notEnabled: Menus in several languages aren't enabled for this restaurant. Contact an administrator to turn them on.
MenuLanguages.mainHint: The language the menu is written in now. Every dish needs at least this.
MenuLanguages.extraHint: Your team can translate dishes and categories into these from the menu editor.

OpeningHours.title: Opening hours
OpeningHours.intro: Shown on your menu as "Open now" or "Closed", on your about page, and to search engines.
OpeningHours.timeZoneHint: Where the restaurant is. Also used to count QR code scans per day.
OpeningHours.notSet: No opening hours yet. Guests don't see any until you add them.
OpeningHours.overnightHint: A closing time earlier than the opening time means after midnight, for example 18:00 – 02:00.

ColorTheme.title: Menu colours
ColorTheme.intro: Choose the colours guests see on your menu, about and dish pages, in light and dark mode.
ColorTheme.enableText: Lets this restaurant's owners design its colours. Turning it off goes back to the default colours but keeps their design.
ColorTheme.notEnabled: Custom colours aren't enabled for this restaurant, so the default colours are used. Contact an administrator to turn them on.
ColorTheme.previewHint: Point at any part of the menu to see which colour it uses; click it to change that colour.

MenuDesign.title: Menu design
MenuDesign.intro: How your dishes are laid out. Every design is one scrolling page with the categories at the top, made for phones.

classic.label: Classic
classic.hint: Cards with the photo beside the text. Suits most menus.

photo-grid.label: Photo grid
photo-grid.hint: Two columns of large photos on phones. For photo-rich menus.

compact.label: Compact
compact.hint: A text list like a printed menu. For long menus without photos.

featuresPage.metaDescription: Digital menus restaurants shape themselves: three designs, their own colours, several languages, QR codes and more.

hero.title: Everything your menu needs
hero.intro: A digital menu your guests open with one scan, and you update in seconds. Try it below on our demo restaurant.

demo.title: Try it yourself
demo.intro: This is Lokanta Demo, a made-up restaurant. Change its design, colours and language, and tap a dish, just as your guests would.
demo.hint: Tap a dish to open it. Real menus work the same way on any phone.

designs.title: Three menu designs
designs.text: Classic, Photo grid or Compact. Pick the one that suits your food and switch any time.

colors.title: Your own colours
colors.text: Choose the background, text, buttons and highlights, for light and dark mode, with a live preview. Or start from a ready-made palette.

fast.title: Built for phones
fast.text: Light, fast pages for guests scanning at the table, with a compact header so the dishes come first.

languages.title: Menus in several languages
languages.text: Offer your menu in English, Turkish, Arabic, Spanish and Russian. Guests see it in their own language, right-to-left included.

search.title: Search and dietary filters
search.text: Guests find dishes by name or ingredient, and filter for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and more.

friendly.title: Friendly for guests
friendly.text: Prices in each guest's own format, dark mode, and one tap opens any dish with its photo and details.

instant.title: Changes go live instantly
instant.text: Change a price, add a dish or mark it sold out, and guests see it straight away. No reprinting.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.text: Show "Open now" or when you open next, worked out in your time zone and shown in the guest's language.

qr.title: QR codes and table cards
qr.text: QR codes with your logo that keep working even if your menu's address changes, plus table cards ready to print.

stats.title: Scan statistics
stats.text: See how many guests opened your menu each day.

google.title: Found on Google
google.text: Search engines understand your menu, dishes, prices and opening hours, in every language you offer.

sharing.title: Links that look good
sharing.text: Links shared on WhatsApp and social media show your name, description and photo.

about.title: Your restaurant's page
about.text: Address and map, phone, social media and delivery app links, all in one place.

team.title: Work as a team
team.text: Invite your staff with a link. Owners manage everything; editors manage the menu.

start.title: Easy to start
start.text: A step-by-step checklist, a private preview before going live, and photos resized automatically when you upload them.

contact.title: Ready for your own menu?
contact.text: Tell us about your restaurant and we'll set it up together.
